title: Tom Sawyer, detective
summary: Tom Sawyer, Detective is a short novel by Mark Twain, first published in 1896, in which Tom Sawyer and Huck Finn travel down the Mississippi and become entangled in a family feud in rural Arkansas. The story begins when Tom and Huck are sent to visit Tom's uncle Silas, a preacher whose household is torn apart by a quarrel with their neighbour Brace Dunlap, who has been rebuffed in his attempt to marry Silas's daughter Benny. On the steamboat, the boys meet a secretive passenger who turns out to be Jake Dunlap, the long-lost twin of the hired man Jubiter Dunlap, a fugitive presumed dead. The narrative moves through a supposed murder, a ghostly sighting, and a jewel robbery in which Tom uses his cleverness to expose the guilty parties. The book is a mixture of mystery, comedy and courtroom drama, told in Huck's colloquial voice, and it was based on an old Swedish criminal case that Twain adapted to an American setting.
